limits: Main-process /proc entries only, not every thread; tool helper threads can be missed.
One0.5s snapshot enumerates tasks sequentially, so its timestamp is not an atomic per-task instant.
Wait/stack counts are sampled observations, not exact blocked durations.
CPU deltas cover only first-to-last observations of a PID/starttime identity, never child CPU counters; short-lived tasks and tails can be missed.
The observer adds syscalls/9p output and potential BPF work; its own CPU does not bound its kernel/tracing impact.
